body.message:
Thank you for the transfer.

However, the amount received is AED 16,275, leaving an outstanding balance of AED 1,400.

This deduction remains unjustified and unsupported by any signed or agreed documentation at the time of check-out.

We will be updating the DET case accordingly to reflect the partial payment and unresolved balance.

Kindly arrange the immediate transfer of the remaining AED 1,400 and confirm once completed.
